construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation authored in this isolated build directory.

shared_schema.input: Exact keys: schema_version (integer 1), synthetic (true), questions ([{id,text}]), documents ([{id,title,content,evidence:[{id,question_id,stance,excerpt}]}]). All text is nonblank. IDs are unique within question/document/evidence namespaces. Evidence references an existing question, uses supports/contradicts/uncertain, and quotes a verbatim substring of its document.
shared_schema.bounds: 1-100 questions, 0-100 documents, up to 1000 evidence items per document and 10000 total, at most 100000 characters per text field. JSON file loading itself is not streaming or byte-limited.
shared_schema.success: status=ok, schema_version=1, synthetic=true, question_results, unresolved_questions, source_inventory, limitations. Each question result contains question_id, question, finding, summary, document_ids_by_stance, distinct_document_count, evidence with document provenance, disagreements, unresolved_questions, and optional optional_summary.
shared_schema.error: status=error, schema_version=1, error={type,message}; CLI emits one JSON object and exits 2.
shared_schema.validation: API and CLI share validate(); common field/text/list/ID validators also validate optional callable output. JSON loader rejects duplicate keys and non-finite constants.
shared_schema.optional_callable: run(payload, summarizer=None). Callable receives a deep copy of one question result and must return exactly {summary: nonblank text, evidence_ids: unique IDs citing all and only that question's evidence}. Failure returns the shared error envelope. Structural validation is not semantic verification.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single integrated functionality: validated documents and annotated excerpts -> question-indexed evidence -> per-document stance aggregation -> findings, disagreements and unresolved questions -> shared JSON response.
Optional injected callable receives the deterministic question result; it cannot alter the core evidence or findings.
behavior: Clearly labeled synthetic example includes opposing cohort findings, unmeasured repeat purchasing, and an accessibility evidence gap.
Findings distinguish disputed, support_only, contradiction_only, uncertain_only and no_evidence.
Explicit support and contradiction produce disagreement even within one document. Cross-document and internal disagreement are distinguished.
Counts use distinct document IDs per stance, never raw quotation frequency. A document may appear under multiple stances.
Unresolved questions identify opposing findings, missing evidence, explicit uncertainty and single-document coverage.
Evidence and sources use stable ID ordering; questions retain input order. No timestamps, randomness, networking or live providers.
Absence of a rule-triggered unresolved question does not establish completeness or truth.

included: Optional offline callable tested with synthetic fixtures

test_outcomes.cli_example: Passed: one JSON object, status ok, exit 0
test_outcomes.cli_errors: Verified usage and missing-file failures exit 2; invalid JSON/schema and decoding failures emit the shared JSON error envelope.
